author: SickProdigy
description: Access-controlled image generation through interchangeable OpenAI and ComfyUI providers.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server configuration, allowlisted role and user IDs, and bounded per-user usage timestamps for rate limiting. Prompts and generated images are sent to the configured provider but are not retained by the cog.
install_msg: Imagine is disabled by default. The bot owner must allow the server with `[p]imagineset server allow`, then a server administrator can configure access. Store OpenAI credentials with `[p]set api openai api_key,<value>`.
name: Imagine
